description: The line plot illustrates the reliability score of SQL generation as a function of cost for three different model ensembles: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is also a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90.
